value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete differentiability classification on the natural substantial class of nonvanishing weights with positive modulus limit, identifies the essential-spectrum transition, and supplies an explicit bounded derivative. The infinite alternating tail obstruction is not detected by known one-variable radius formulas and matters to Banach norm smoothness and optimization.
